knownLimitations: One generation at a time; the active-job wall deadline is 360 s including topology and normalisation.
A full 5-candidate demo B run takes about 150 s, so a supported demo can sit well inside the deadline but is not interactive.
The solver often returns FEASIBLE rather than OPTIMAL, and ranking is this engine's ordering, not architectural truth.
Internal walls are reported on a 100 mm raster and their 90 mm centre-line area is not subtracted from rooms.
Openings are symbolic: not every room is guaranteed a door.
Architectural infeasibility is a limited search result unless the required minima alone exceed the envelope.
